第66章 猪肉卖爆了-《赶山1957：二斤猪肉换个媳妇》

“对！”李青山点头道。

“不错，有胆量！”

周正点了点头，旋即道：“你们这阵子要是去老林子的话稍微注意一下，今天和你们说的通缉犯大黑痦子，很有可能就躲在老林子里，要是赤手空拳就算了，关键是这家伙手里有把枪，要是遇到了不要惊动他，回来的时候去乡镇派出所找我就行。”

“还有枪？”

“长的还是短的？”

李青山眼前一亮，开口问道。

“短的！”周正道。

“那倒是危险！”

“周公安放心，我们要是上山遇到了，肯定第一时间找你汇报。”

李青山开口道。

如今自己手中的枪械短缺，队伍里也只有自己一把单管猎枪，大壮，二壮和赵红旗都是拎着柴刀，要是再遇到野猪群了，最多也就是一枪放到一个。

可要是四个人都有枪，同时出枪！！

百发百中的情况下，能同时放到四只，要是双管猎枪就更棒了，能连续开两枪，肯定能放倒更多的野猪。

短枪的话，威力不太足。

现在比较常见的短枪也就是54式和52式手枪，这两种都是军中常用，民间比较常见的手枪都是上一个时代遗留下来的产物，比如说驳壳枪，勃朗宁的撸子系列，有什么马牌撸子，袖珍撸子，抢牌撸子。

还有一些是民间自己制作的手枪，也就是大家所说的撅把子，不过这东西因为是自己制作的，也没那么精良，一次只能发射一枚子弹，而且都是自己制作的火药子弹，射程也只有二十来米，说实话，还没李青山的长弓好用。

但是，手枪要是瞄的准，一枪命中野猪的脑袋，也能一枪毙命，比如说这次，直接从耳道穿过去，脑浆子都给他崩出来了。

“来，我帮你们一把！”

周正撸了撸袖子，上前一步帮忙推车，一伙人有说有笑，很快便到了集市上开始卖肉，周正则是回了单位，李青山特意找了个阴凉的地方，这地方刚好距离上次吃早点的那个铺子挺近的。

这附近阴凉的地方，除了李青山之外，还有几个摆台卖一些农副产品之类的。

“野猪肉，野猪肉，三毛五的野猪肉，今天只要三毛三，买二斤送一两咯！”

李青山将板车放好后，便扯着嗓子开始喊道。

这个时候，猪肉的价格更贵一些，四毛钱一斤，野猪肉的价格便宜一些，三毛四。

李青山卖三毛三的话，就有一些竞争力了。

"Yes!" Li Qingshan nodded.

"Yes, you have courage!"

Zhou Zheng nodded and said immediately: "If you go to the old forest these days, be careful. The wanted criminal Da Heizizi I told you today is very likely hiding in the old forest. Forget it with bare hands. The key is that this guy has a gun in his hand. If you encounter him, don't alert him. Just go to the township police station to find me when you come back."

"And a gun?"

"Long or short?"

Li Qingshan's eyes lit up and he asked.

"Short!" Zhou Zheng said.

"That's dangerous!"

"Don't worry, Public Security Zhou. If we encounter someone on the mountain, we will definitely report to you as soon as possible."

Li Qingshan said.

Now that he is short of firearms, he only has a single-barreled shotgun in the team. Da Zhuang, Er Zhuang and Zhao Hongqi are all carrying hatchets. If they encounter a herd of wild boars again, the most they can do is shoot one at a time.

But what if four people all have guns and shoot them at the same time!!

With perfect accuracy, it can kill four wild boars at the same time. It would be even better if it had a double-barreled shotgun. If it can fire two shots in a row, it will definitely bring down more wild boars.

As for short guns, they are not very powerful.

The more common short guns now are the Type 54 and Type 52 pistols, both of which are commonly used in the military. The more common pistols among civilians are all products left over from the previous era, such as shell guns, Browning's series of handguns, horse-brand handguns, pocket handguns, and grab-brand handguns.

There are also some handguns made by civilians, which are what everyone calls pistols. However, because they are made by themselves, they are not that sophisticated. They can only fire one bullet at a time, and they are all self-made gunpowder bullets. The range is only about 20 meters. To be honest, they are not as useful as Li Qingshan's longbow.

However, if the pistol is aimed accurately, it can kill a wild boar with one shot in the head. For example, this time, it went directly through the ear canal and the brains were blown out.

"Come on, let me help you!"

Zhou Zheng rolled up his sleeves and stepped forward to help push the cart. The group chatted and laughed, and soon they arrived at the market and started selling meat. Zhou Zheng returned to his work. Li Qingshan specially found a shady place, which happened to be quite close to the shop where he had breakfast last time.

In the shady area nearby, besides Li Qingshan, there are several stalls selling some agricultural and sideline products.

"Wild boar, wild boar, 35 cents for wild boar, today it's only 33 cents, buy two kilograms and get one or two for free!"

After Li Qingshan put the cart away, he started shouting at the top of his lungs.

At this time, the price of pork is more expensive, 40 cents per pound, and the price of wild boar is cheaper, 34 cents per pound.

If Li Qingshan sells for 30 cents, he will be somewhat competitive.
